description: Any2Full: metric depth completion that prompts Depth Anything V2 with a sparse depth map of any pattern and density, in small, base and large. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Details
  • Paper: Any to Full: Prompting Depth Anything for Depth Completion in One Stage, ECCV 2026, 2026-03-05
  • Original code: https://github.com/zhiyuandaily/Any2Full at 780edf6
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/zhiyuandaily/Any2Full/blob/main/LICENSE and the Hugging Face model card zhiyuandaily/Any2Full (license: apache-2.0)
  • Training data: Training data and code not released yet (arXiv 2603.05711); the ViT and head start from Depth Anything V2
  • Options: short_side = 518 (>= 14)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: any2full-s, any2full-b, any2full-l
  • Outputs: depth; kind: metric
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): any2full-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); any2full-b 3000x4000 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved); any2full-l 3000x4000 (1.2 GiB peak allocated, 1.3 reserved)
  • any2full-b 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 97 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • any2full-l 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • any2full-s load / first call: portable 0.31 s / 0.359 s
  • any2full-b load / first call: portable 6.38 s / 3.337 s
  • any2full-l load / first call: portable 1.45 s / 0.298 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1.5 % and p99 <= 5 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • The depth map is required: call the model with prompt_depth= a metric map in metres (any size, sparse points or holes as 0 / NaN / inf). The output is fitted to it by scale and shift in disparity, so it needs at least two distinct valid values.
  • Export has a fixed input size.
